title: Khmelnytskyi win Higher League
description: Khmelnytskyi have won the Higher League title as they won the Final series against Chernovtsi 2-1. In the decisive third game Khmelnytskyi posted a 93-88 win. They managed to win the last two quarters of the game for the trophy. Mikita Bazilev (183-PG-97) stepped up with 22 points and Vadim Paliukh (190-F-94) netted 20. Vladislav Lisanenko (195-SF-93) replied with 25 points and 12 rebounds in a loss.
